Proyek jalan menjadi bagian konflik mengenai kehadiran negara di pegunungan. Keluarga di sekitar operasi mengungsi, termasuk anak yang tidak terlibat serangan. Komunikasi PBB meneruskan dugaan serangan darat serta udara dan meminta jawaban Indonesia.

Laporan Juni 2019 mengikuti anak serta keluarga yang tinggal jauh dari kampung. Ketakutan, pendidikan terputus dan kesulitan pangan membuat krisis melampaui bentrokan antarpasukan. Warga yang berlindung di hutan atau permukiman lain kehilangan kebun serta hubungan yang menopang kehidupan di rumah. Pekerja bantuan dan guru berusaha mempertahankan dukungan ketika keselamatan serta akses belum pasti.

Nduga menjadikan pengungsian sipil persoalan utama konflik pegunungan kemudian. Operasi yang disebut memulihkan keamanan dapat meninggalkan masyarakat tanpa jalan pulang atau kehidupan biasa. Surat PBB merekam dugaan yang memerlukan jawaban, bukan penyelidikan selesai, sedangkan laporan keluarga pengungsi memberi pengalaman harian di baliknya. Pangan, sekolah dan kepulangan aman menjadi tuntutan mendesak bersama pertanggungjawaban kekerasan langsung. Sumber: Communication to Indonesia concerning Nduga UN Special Procedures · 2019 https://spcommreports.ohchr.org/TMResultsBase/DownLoadPublicCommunicationFile?gId=24508; Frightened and displaced: Papua children haunted by conflict Al Jazeera · 5 June 2019 https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/6/5/frightened-and-displaced-papua-children-haunted-by-conflict

text.en:
The present displacement case has a major starting point in the December 2018 killings at a Trans-Papua road worksite and the subsequent security operations. Accounts of the victims and circumstances differed; Human Rights Watch called for investigation and protection of civilians on all sides.

Later monitoring follows people living away from their villages, the interruption of schooling and healthcare, and the conditions needed for safe return. A district-wide total cannot be inferred from one incident or one destination. Nduga has its own chronology: figures and events from Puncak or Intan Jaya should not be imported into it. Access for independent reporters and humanitarian workers affects what can be verified. Sources: Indonesia: Papuan militants kill 17 https://www.hrw.org/news/2018/12/09/indonesia-papuan-militants-kill-17; Papua Monitor: second quarter 2026 https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/; Displaced children attend emergency school https://projects.voanews.com/kebebasan-pers-papua/indonesian/impact/pengungsi-konflik-nduga-bangun-sekolah-darurat.html; UN experts call for humanitarian access https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2022/03/indonesia-un-experts-sound-alarm-serious-papua-abuses-call-urgent-aid; Church network reports intensified operations https://www.oikoumene.org/news/human-rights-groups-see-extreme-increase-in-military-deployments-and-operations-in-papua
text.pmy:
Kasus pengungsian sekarang memiliki titik awal penting pada pembunuhan di lokasi kerja jalan Trans-Papua pada Desember 2018 dan operasi keamanan berikutnya. Penuturan tentang korban serta keadaan kejadian berbeda; Human Rights Watch meminta penyelidikan dan pelindungan warga sipil dari semua pihak.

Pemantauan berikutnya mengikuti warga yang tinggal jauh dari kampung, terputusnya sekolah serta layanan kesehatan, dan kondisi untuk pulang dengan aman. Jumlah seluruh kabupaten tidak dapat disimpulkan dari satu kejadian atau satu tempat tujuan. Nduga memiliki kronologi tersendiri; angka dan peristiwa Puncak atau Intan Jaya tidak boleh dipindahkan ke sini. Akses jurnalis independen serta pekerja kemanusiaan memengaruhi verifikasi. Sumber: Indonesia: Papuan militants kill 17 https://www.hrw.org/news/2018/12/09/indonesia-papuan-militants-kill-17; Papua Monitor: second quarter 2026 https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/; Displaced children attend emergency school https://projects.voanews.com/kebebasan-pers-papua/indonesian/impact/pengungsi-konflik-nduga-bangun-sekolah-darurat.html; UN experts call for humanitarian access https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2022/03/indonesia-un-experts-sound-alarm-serious-papua-abuses-call-urgent-aid; Church network reports intensified operations https://www.oikoumene.org/news/human-rights-groups-see-extreme-increase-in-military-deployments-and-operations-in-papua

text.en:
Freeport’s first Indonesian contract was signed in 1967, before Pepera. Mining development connected the highlands with lowland processing, settlements and transport infrastructure. Amungme relationships with highland land and Kamoro relationships with rivers and coastal livelihoods give this history its local context.

Ownership, revenue and jobs answer only part of the question. Land access, compensation, tailings and the river–coast system require community accounts and environmental evidence alongside company reports. The 2018 change in ownership did not itself establish that these concerns were resolved. Watch follows specific agreements and reported effects rather than treating every Mimika story as a mining development. Sources: History of PT Freeport Indonesia https://ptfi.co.id/en/about/history; HUT ke-59 Freeport: Bangkit Bersama Menuju Operasi Berkelanjutan https://ebk.ptfi.co.id/id/video/hut-ke-59-freeport-bangkit-bersama-menuju-operasi-berkelanjutan; First Freeport contract https://www.fcx.com/about/history
text.pmy:
Kontrak pertama Freeport dengan Indonesia ditandatangani pada 1967, sebelum Pepera. Pengembangan tambang menghubungkan pegunungan dengan pengolahan, permukiman, dan pengangkutan di dataran rendah. Hubungan Amungme dengan tanah pegunungan serta Kamoro dengan sungai dan penghidupan pesisir memberi konteks setempat.

Kepemilikan, pendapatan, dan pekerjaan hanya menjawab sebagian persoalan. Akses tanah, ganti rugi, tailing, serta hubungan sungai dan pesisir memerlukan penuturan masyarakat dan bukti lingkungan bersama laporan perusahaan. Perubahan kepemilikan 2018 tidak dengan sendirinya menyelesaikan persoalan tersebut. Watch mengikuti perjanjian serta dampak tertentu, bukan menganggap setiap berita Mimika sebagai perkembangan tambang. Sumber: History of PT Freeport Indonesia https://ptfi.co.id/en/about/history; HUT ke-59 Freeport: Bangkit Bersama Menuju Operasi Berkelanjutan https://ebk.ptfi.co.id/id/video/hut-ke-59-freeport-bangkit-bersama-menuju-operasi-berkelanjutan; First Freeport contract https://www.fcx.com/about/history

text.en:
Puncak’s displacement history includes violence around Beoga and later operations elsewhere in the regency. After two teachers were killed in April 2021, ANTARA interviewed a health worker seeking evacuation, describing closed shops and shortages. That episode connects civilian safety directly with the ability to keep local services operating.

Later monitoring records renewed violence and displacement in Puncak. Returning home requires more than a decline in headlines: residents need safety, food, functioning services and access to their villages. Puncak and Puncak Jaya are different regencies, and this case also remains separate from Nduga and Intan Jaya. Sources: Pengungsi Beoga Puncak minta dievakuasi https://papua.antaranews.com/berita/629122/pengungsi-beoga-puncak-minta-dievakuasi-persediaan-makanan-mulai-menipis; Papua Monitor: second quarter 2026 https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/; UN experts call for humanitarian access https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2022/03/indonesia-un-experts-sound-alarm-serious-papua-abuses-call-urgent-aid; Church network reports intensified operations https://www.oikoumene.org/news/human-rights-groups-see-extreme-increase-in-military-deployments-and-operations-in-papua; Komnas HAM hears from displaced residents https://www.puncakkab.go.id/publikasi/berita/568/komnasham-ri-tiba-di-puncak-dengar-langsung-keluhan-para-pengungsi
text.pmy:
Sejarah pengungsian Puncak mencakup kekerasan sekitar Beoga serta operasi berikutnya di bagian lain kabupaten. Setelah dua guru dibunuh pada April 2021, ANTARA mewawancarai tenaga kesehatan yang meminta evakuasi dan menjelaskan penutupan kios serta kekurangan bahan makanan. Peristiwa ini menghubungkan keselamatan warga dengan keberlanjutan layanan setempat.

Pemantauan berikutnya mencatat kekerasan dan pengungsian baru di Puncak. Kepulangan membutuhkan lebih dari berkurangnya berita: warga memerlukan keamanan, pangan, layanan yang berfungsi, dan akses kampung. Puncak dan Puncak Jaya merupakan kabupaten berbeda. Kasus ini juga terpisah dari Nduga dan Intan Jaya. Sumber: Pengungsi Beoga Puncak minta dievakuasi https://papua.antaranews.com/berita/629122/pengungsi-beoga-puncak-minta-dievakuasi-persediaan-makanan-mulai-menipis; Papua Monitor: second quarter 2026 https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/; UN experts call for humanitarian access https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2022/03/indonesia-un-experts-sound-alarm-serious-papua-abuses-call-urgent-aid; Church network reports intensified operations https://www.oikoumene.org/news/human-rights-groups-see-extreme-increase-in-military-deployments-and-operations-in-papua; Komnas HAM hears from displaced residents https://www.puncakkab.go.id/publikasi/berita/568/komnasham-ri-tiba-di-puncak-dengar-langsung-keluhan-para-pengungsi

text.en:
Violence around Sugapa and surrounding districts has displaced civilians and limited access to services. The killing of Pastor Yeremia Zanambani on 19 September 2020 became a major reference point in church and humanitarian investigations. Those records need attribution and should not be reduced to assumptions about the motives behind every later incident.

Human Rights Monitor’s second-quarter 2026 account describes further operations, civilian harm and displacement in Intan Jaya. Watch follows the specific villages, dates and sources involved, including whether assistance reaches displaced families and what would make return possible. A regional estimate of displaced people is not an Intan Jaya count. Sources: The Intan Jaya conflict http://www.asia-pacific-solidarity.net/news/2021-01-07/intan-jaya-conflict-risk-of-more-widespread-violence-future.html; Papua Monitor: second quarter 2026 https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/; Gold Rush report examines mining and security https://www.amnesty.org/en/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/ASA2152572022ENGLISH.pdf; UN experts call for humanitarian access https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2022/03/indonesia-un-experts-sound-alarm-serious-papua-abuses-call-urgent-aid; Church network reports intensified operations https://www.oikoumene.org/news/human-rights-groups-see-extreme-increase-in-military-deployments-and-operations-in-papua
text.pmy:
Kekerasan sekitar Sugapa dan distrik sekitarnya menyebabkan pengungsian serta membatasi akses layanan. Pembunuhan Pendeta Yeremia Zanambani pada 19 September 2020 menjadi rujukan penting dalam penyelidikan gereja dan tim kemanusiaan. Catatan tersebut perlu atribusi dan tidak boleh diringkas menjadi dugaan motif untuk seluruh kejadian berikutnya.

Human Rights Monitor pada kuartal kedua 2026 menjelaskan operasi, korban sipil, serta pengungsian lebih lanjut di Intan Jaya. Watch mengikuti kampung, tanggal, dan sumber tertentu, termasuk akses bantuan bagi keluarga pengungsi serta kondisi yang memungkinkan kepulangan. Perkiraan pengungsi seluruh wilayah bukan jumlah Intan Jaya. Sumber: The Intan Jaya conflict http://www.asia-pacific-solidarity.net/news/2021-01-07/intan-jaya-conflict-risk-of-more-widespread-violence-future.html; Papua Monitor: second quarter 2026 https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/; Gold Rush report examines mining and security https://www.amnesty.org/en/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/ASA2152572022ENGLISH.pdf; UN experts call for humanitarian access https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2022/03/indonesia-un-experts-sound-alarm-serious-papua-abuses-call-urgent-aid; Church network reports intensified operations https://www.oikoumene.org/news/human-rights-groups-see-extreme-increase-in-military-deployments-and-operations-in-papua

text.en:
Civic space concerns the practical ability to report, organise, discuss and make cultural work. The August 2019 anti-racism protests and internet shutdown are major reference points. The Jakarta administrative court later found the shutdown unlawful, but that ruling did not establish that every subsequent restriction ended.

Recent cases include journalism, student organising and public film screenings. Each needs its own date, authority and evidence. Pesta Babi links debate about South Papua’s land projects with the ability to show and discuss a documentary; monitoring reports of intimidation and dispersal should remain attributed. Disagreement with a work and an action preventing people from seeing it are different things. Sources: If It’s Not Racism, What Is It? https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/09/18/if-its-not-racism-what-is-it/discrimination-and-other-abuses-against-papuans-in; Court ruling on internet blackout https://www.amnesty.id/kabar-terbaru/siaran-pers/court-ruling-on-internet-blackout-is-a-rare-victory-for-freedom-of-expression-in-papua/06/2020/; Papua Monitor: second quarter 2026 https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/; Internet shutdown across Papua https://globalfreedomofexpression.columbia.edu/cases/alliance-of-independent-journalists-v-minister-of-communication/
text.pmy:
Ruang sipil menyangkut kemampuan nyata untuk meliput, berorganisasi, berdiskusi, dan membuat karya budaya. Protes antirasisme Agustus 2019 serta pemutusan internet menjadi rujukan penting. Pengadilan administrasi Jakarta kemudian menyatakan pemutusan itu melanggar hukum, tetapi putusan tidak membuktikan bahwa seluruh pembatasan berikutnya berakhir.

Kasus baru mencakup jurnalisme, organisasi mahasiswa, serta pemutaran film publik. Masing-masing membutuhkan tanggal, pihak yang bertindak, dan bukti tersendiri. Pesta Babi menghubungkan perdebatan proyek tanah Papua Selatan dengan kebebasan menonton serta membahas dokumenter. Laporan intimidasi dan pembubaran tetap diberi atribusi. Ketidaksetujuan terhadap karya berbeda dari tindakan menghalangi orang menontonnya. Sumber: If It’s Not Racism, What Is It? https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/09/18/if-its-not-racism-what-is-it/discrimination-and-other-abuses-against-papuans-in; Court ruling on internet blackout https://www.amnesty.id/kabar-terbaru/siaran-pers/court-ruling-on-internet-blackout-is-a-rare-victory-for-freedom-of-expression-in-papua/06/2020/; Papua Monitor: second quarter 2026 https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/; Internet shutdown across Papua https://globalfreedomofexpression.columbia.edu/cases/alliance-of-independent-journalists-v-minister-of-communication/

text.en:
Awyu communities in Boven Digoel have challenged plantation permissions affecting customary forests. Hendrikus Woro’s case concerns PT Indo Asiana Lestari’s environmental approval. Proceedings involving PT Kartika Cipta Pratama and PT Megakarya Jaya Raya are separate and should not be merged into one court outcome.

The Supreme Court rejected the IAL cassation in a decision made on 18 September 2024, with a dissenting judge; the coalition discussed the accessible ruling on 1 November. A judgment on that permission does not determine every customary-land claim or establish what has been cleared. The continuing questions concern consent, legal recognition, forest access and the actual effects of each company’s activities. Sources: Mahkamah Agung tolak kasasi suku Awyu https://www.walhi.or.id/mahkamah-agung-tolak-kasasi-suku-awyu-perjuangan-selamatkan-hutan-papua-kian-berat; Hendrikus Woro files environmental lawsuit https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/58630/west-papuan-indigenous-defender-files-lawsuit-over-palm-oil-company-forestland-grab/; Jayapura court rejects lawsuit https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/62817/verdict-a-setback-for-awyu-indigenous-people-and-papuan-forests/
text.pmy:
Masyarakat Awyu di Boven Digoel menggugat izin perkebunan yang memengaruhi hutan adat. Perkara Hendrikus Woro menyangkut persetujuan lingkungan PT Indo Asiana Lestari. Perkara PT Kartika Cipta Pratama dan PT Megakarya Jaya Raya berbeda dan tidak boleh disatukan sebagai satu hasil pengadilan.

Mahkamah Agung menolak kasasi IAL melalui keputusan 18 September 2024, dengan seorang hakim menyatakan pendapat berbeda. Koalisi membahas putusan yang sudah dapat diakses pada 1 November. Putusan izin tersebut tidak menentukan seluruh klaim tanah adat atau membuktikan luas pembukaan. Pertanyaan berlanjut menyangkut persetujuan, pengakuan hukum, akses hutan, dan dampak nyata aktivitas tiap perusahaan. Sumber: Mahkamah Agung tolak kasasi suku Awyu https://www.walhi.or.id/mahkamah-agung-tolak-kasasi-suku-awyu-perjuangan-selamatkan-hutan-papua-kian-berat; Hendrikus Woro files environmental lawsuit https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/58630/west-papuan-indigenous-defender-files-lawsuit-over-palm-oil-company-forestland-grab/; Jayapura court rejects lawsuit https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/62817/verdict-a-setback-for-awyu-indigenous-people-and-papuan-forests/

title.en: South Papua food and energy estate
title.pmy: Proyek pangan dan energi Papua Selatan

text.en:
Merauke’s food and energy projects take place on customary territories with existing forests, sago landscapes, gardens and clan relationships. Malind testimony gathered during MIFEE describes how land negotiation and forest conversion affected food sources and everyday life. These are working landscapes and social relationships, not vacant land.

MIFEE began in 2010. Later strategic projects include sugar and bioethanol development and a separate rice programme, with different companies, approvals and sites. The questions are which territories are affected, how consent was obtained, what has actually been cleared, and whether communities retain access to food, water and livelihoods. Awyu litigation in Boven Digoel is a related but distinct case. Sources: A sweetness like unto death: voices of the indigenous Malind of Merauke https://www.forestpeoples.org/publications-resources/reports/article/a-sweetness-like-unto-death-voices-of-the-indigenous-malind-of-merauke-papua/; Merauke National Strategic Project timeline https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/; Elegi Selatan Papua https://pusaka.or.id/event/elegi-selatan-papua/; MIFEE launched https://aseas.univie.ac.at/index.php/aseas/article/view/2571/2159; Civil-society objections to MIFEE https://tapol.org/press-statements/mifee-project-violates-human-rights
text.pmy:
Proyek pangan dan energi Merauke berlangsung di wilayah adat yang sudah memiliki hutan, bentang sagu, kebun, dan hubungan antarmarga. Kesaksian Malind selama MIFEE menjelaskan dampak perundingan tanah serta perubahan hutan terhadap sumber pangan dan hidup sehari-hari. Wilayah tersebut merupakan ruang penghidupan dan hubungan sosial, bukan tanah kosong.

MIFEE dimulai pada 2010. Proyek strategis berikutnya mencakup gula dan bioetanol serta program padi yang terpisah, dengan perusahaan, persetujuan, dan lokasi berbeda. Pertanyaannya menyangkut wilayah terdampak, proses persetujuan, pembukaan yang benar-benar terjadi, serta akses masyarakat terhadap pangan, air, dan penghidupan. Gugatan Awyu di Boven Digoel merupakan kasus terkait yang berbeda. Sumber: A sweetness like unto death: voices of the indigenous Malind of Merauke https://www.forestpeoples.org/publications-resources/reports/article/a-sweetness-like-unto-death-voices-of-the-indigenous-malind-of-merauke-papua/; Merauke National Strategic Project timeline https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/; Elegi Selatan Papua https://pusaka.or.id/event/elegi-selatan-papua/; MIFEE launched https://aseas.univie.ac.at/index.php/aseas/article/view/2571/2159; Civil-society objections to MIFEE https://tapol.org/press-statements/mifee-project-violates-human-rights

text.en:
Mining in Raja Ampat involves particular islands, permits, companies and customary territories. Tourism and marine conservation make the region internationally visible, but the effects of extraction also concern forest, freshwater and local livelihoods on the islands themselves.

On 10 June 2025 the government announced four permit revocations, while distinguishing PT Gag Nikel, whose permit remained. This was not an announcement that all mining had ended. Following the decision requires evidence of operations, compliance and site recovery, as well as community accounts. An island-specific observation should not be presented as a measurement for the whole archipelago. Sources: Four mining permits revoked in Raja Ampat https://www.esdm.go.id/en/media-center/news-archives/pemerintah-cabut-empat-izin-perusahaan-tambang-di-raja-ampat; PTUN orders disclosure of Raja Ampat permit-revocation records https://www.greenpeace.org/indonesia/siaran-pers/67809/greenpeace-menang-ptun-perintahkan-pemerintah-buka-sk-pencabutan-izin-4-tambang-nikel-di-raja-ampat/; Gag Nikel resumes under oversight https://asianews.network/indonesia-government-vows-stricter-oversight-as-gag-nikel-restarts-raja-ampat-mine/
text.pmy:
Pertambangan Raja Ampat melibatkan pulau, izin, perusahaan, dan wilayah adat tertentu. Pariwisata serta konservasi laut membuat kawasan ini dikenal luas, tetapi dampak ekstraksi juga menyangkut hutan, air tawar, dan penghidupan penduduk pulau.

Pada 10 Juni 2025 pemerintah mengumumkan pencabutan empat izin dan membedakannya dari PT Gag Nikel yang izinnya tetap berlaku. Pengumuman itu bukan penghentian seluruh pertambangan. Pemantauan keputusan memerlukan bukti operasi, kepatuhan, serta pemulihan lokasi bersama penuturan masyarakat. Pengamatan satu pulau tidak dapat disajikan sebagai ukuran seluruh kepulauan. Sumber: Four mining permits revoked in Raja Ampat https://www.esdm.go.id/en/media-center/news-archives/pemerintah-cabut-empat-izin-perusahaan-tambang-di-raja-ampat; PTUN orders disclosure of Raja Ampat permit-revocation records https://www.greenpeace.org/indonesia/siaran-pers/67809/greenpeace-menang-ptun-perintahkan-pemerintah-buka-sk-pencabutan-izin-4-tambang-nikel-di-raja-ampat/; Gag Nikel resumes under oversight https://asianews.network/indonesia-government-vows-stricter-oversight-as-gag-nikel-restarts-raja-ampat-mine/

text.en: Merauke’s present projects have a longer background. The 2013 Malind field study describes how MIFEE land negotiations and forest conversion affected community food sources and relationships. Pusaka’s strategic-project timeline follows later decisions, including the 2023 designation and the April 2024 sugar and bioethanol task force. These records concern related but distinct programmes. They do not justify treating every concession, rice project and plantation as one unchanged estate. Pusaka’s August 2026 assessment launch brings the reported effects on customary communities and the environment alongside government development targets. Its event description is a record of Pusaka’s findings and position; the full assessment and site evidence are needed for specific conclusions. Planned hectares are not cleared hectares. The practical stakes concern who retains access to forest food, gardens and water, how consent is recorded, and what remedies exist when land negotiations are disputed.
text.pmy: Proyek Merauke sekarang memiliki latar yang lebih panjang. Kajian lapangan Malind 2013 menjelaskan pengaruh perundingan tanah MIFEE serta perubahan hutan terhadap sumber pangan dan hubungan masyarakat. Linimasa proyek strategis Pusaka mengikuti keputusan berikutnya, termasuk penetapan 2023 dan satgas gula serta bioetanol April 2024. Catatan ini menyangkut program terkait yang berbeda, bukan alasan menyatukan seluruh konsesi, proyek padi, dan perkebunan menjadi satu kawasan yang tidak berubah. Peluncuran kajian Pusaka pada Agustus 2026 mempertemukan laporan dampak bagi masyarakat adat dan lingkungan dengan target pembangunan pemerintah. Deskripsi kegiatan mencatat temuan serta posisi Pusaka; kajian lengkap dan bukti lokasi diperlukan untuk kesimpulan tertentu. Luas rencana berbeda dari luas yang dibuka. Persoalan nyata menyangkut akses pangan hutan, kebun, dan air, pencatatan persetujuan, serta pemulihan ketika perundingan tanah disengketakan.

text.en: Human Rights Monitor’s April–June 2026 review reports further operations and armed violence in Puncak and Intan Jaya, with operations also recorded in Nduga and other regencies. It describes civilian harm, fear and interruption of health and education services. These are attributed monitoring findings. Regional displacement estimates cannot be transferred to an individual case, and the report’s coverage period should remain visible when interpreting its account. Earlier reporting from Beoga shows how these pressures can affect services: in April 2021 a health worker told ANTARA that fear, closed shops and food shortages followed the killing of two teachers. That historical episode is not proof of the same conditions in every village today. It identifies the questions to test in new reporting: whether staff can work safely, whether families can reach food and care, and whether returning residents can actually use their villages and schools.
text.pmy: Tinjauan Human Rights Monitor April–Juni 2026 melaporkan operasi serta kekerasan bersenjata di Puncak dan Intan Jaya, dengan operasi juga tercatat di Nduga serta kabupaten lain. Laporan menggambarkan korban sipil, ketakutan, dan gangguan layanan kesehatan serta pendidikan. Ini merupakan temuan pemantauan yang diberi atribusi. Perkiraan pengungsian regional tidak dapat dipindahkan ke satu kasus; periode pelaporan perlu tetap diperhatikan. Laporan Beoga sebelumnya memperlihatkan pengaruh tekanan ini terhadap layanan: pada April 2021 tenaga kesehatan mengatakan kepada ANTARA bahwa ketakutan, kios tutup, dan kekurangan pangan terjadi setelah dua guru dibunuh. Peristiwa lama itu tidak membuktikan kondisi yang sama di setiap kampung sekarang. Peristiwa tersebut membantu menentukan pertanyaan bagi peliputan baru: keselamatan petugas, akses pangan dan perawatan, serta kemampuan warga yang pulang memakai kampung dan sekolahnya.

text.en: The second-quarter HRM review records intimidation and dispersal of Pesta Babi screenings, while noting the documentary’s online release on 22 May 2026. This connects two distinct subjects: what the film says about southern land projects, and whether audiences and organisers can show and discuss it. The monitoring claims require attribution; a work’s availability online does not by itself settle whether a local public screening can proceed safely. The 2020 administrative-court ruling on the 2019 internet shutdown provides an earlier legal reference for access to information. It concerns specific government actions, not a finding that all restrictions subsequently ended. New screening, student and journalism cases need their own dates, actors and evidence. Following them separately makes it possible to assess remedies and recurring practices without turning every controversy into one continuous event.
text.pmy: Tinjauan HRM kuartal kedua mencatat intimidasi serta pembubaran pemutaran Pesta Babi dan perilisan daring pada 22 Mei 2026. Ini menghubungkan dua persoalan berbeda: isi film tentang proyek tanah di selatan, serta kemampuan khalayak dan penyelenggara menonton maupun membahasnya. Klaim pemantauan perlu atribusi; ketersediaan karya secara daring tidak dengan sendirinya memastikan keamanan pemutaran publik setempat. Putusan pengadilan administrasi 2020 tentang pemutusan internet 2019 memberi rujukan hukum sebelumnya bagi akses informasi. Putusan menyangkut tindakan pemerintah tertentu, bukan menyatakan seluruh pembatasan setelahnya berakhir. Kasus pemutaran, mahasiswa, dan jurnalisme baru memerlukan tanggal, pelaku, serta bukti sendiri. Pemantauan terpisah memungkinkan penilaian pemulihan dan praktik berulang tanpa menjadikan seluruh kontroversi sebagai satu peristiwa terus-menerus.

text.en: Rosina Tabuni displays her knotted bags outside her home in Tolmis, Wamena. Her practice includes bags, vests, shawls and bracelets. She describes the work as supporting her family, her children’s schooling and activities in her church.
text.pmy: Rosina Tabuni memajang tas rajut di depan rumahnya di Tolmis, Wamena. Karyanya mencakup tas, rompi, selendang, dan gelang. Ia menjelaskan bahwa pekerjaan itu menopang keluarga, sekolah anak, serta kegiatan gerejanya.

text.en: A maker’s portrait from the Noken Wamena interview with Rosina Tabuni. The accompanying account describes her materials, different forms of noken work and the difficulty of finding a suitable place to sell it.
text.pmy: Potret pembuat dari wawancara Noken Wamena dengan Rosina Tabuni. Penuturan pendamping menjelaskan bahan, beragam bentuk karya noken, serta kesulitan memperoleh tempat berjualan yang layak.

text.en: Knotted or woven bags used in everyday work and exchange. The photograph records noken in 2017; its date is not the origin of the practice.
text.pmy: Tas rajut atau anyaman untuk pekerjaan sehari-hari dan pertukaran. Foto merekam noken pada 2017; tanggal itu bukan awal praktiknya.

title.pmy: Pembunuhan di lokasi kerja dan tanggapan

text.en: The December killings and subsequent operations are a starting point in the present displacement chronology. HRW described disputed accounts and called for civilian protection. Sources: Human Rights Watch https://www.hrw.org/news/2018/12/09/indonesia-papuan-militants-kill-17
text.pmy: Pembunuhan Desember dan operasi berikutnya menjadi titik awal penting kronologi pengungsian sekarang. HRW mencatat penuturan yang berbeda dan meminta pelindungan warga sipil. Sumber: Human Rights Watch https://www.hrw.org/news/2018/12/09/indonesia-papuan-militants-kill-17

title.pmy: Anak pengungsi belajar di sekolah darurat

text.en: VOA visited a temporary school in the Weneroma church compound in Wamena. Volunteer teachers and families were trying to continue children’s education after displacement from Nduga. Children’s school records and funding were difficult to transfer, showing how the consequences persisted beyond the initial flight from home. Sources: VOA · Alam Burhanan https://projects.voanews.com/kebebasan-pers-papua/indonesian/impact/pengungsi-konflik-nduga-bangun-sekolah-darurat.html
text.pmy: VOA mengunjungi sekolah darurat di kompleks gereja Weneroma, Wamena. Guru sukarela dan keluarga berusaha melanjutkan pendidikan anak setelah mengungsi dari Nduga. Pemindahan data sekolah dan dukungan biaya menghadapi kendala, memperlihatkan dampak pengungsian yang berlanjut setelah warga meninggalkan rumah. Sumber: VOA · Alam Burhanan https://projects.voanews.com/kebebasan-pers-papua/indonesian/impact/pengungsi-konflik-nduga-bangun-sekolah-darurat.html

title.en: UN experts call for humanitarian access

text.en: UN experts described prolonged displacement since late 2018, interrupted food, healthcare and education, and restrictions on relief access across highland Papua. Their appeal calls for independent investigations and durable solutions. The regional estimates cover several conflict areas, rather than this regency alone. Sources: OHCHR · UN Special Procedures https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2022/03/indonesia-un-experts-sound-alarm-serious-papua-abuses-call-urgent-aid
text.pmy: Pakar PBB menggambarkan pengungsian berkepanjangan sejak akhir 2018, gangguan pangan, kesehatan, dan pendidikan, serta keterbatasan akses bantuan di pegunungan Papua. Mereka meminta penyelidikan independen dan penyelesaian berkelanjutan. Perkiraan regional mencakup sejumlah wilayah konflik, bukan kabupaten ini saja. Sumber: OHCHR · UN Special Procedures https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2022/03/indonesia-un-experts-sound-alarm-serious-papua-abuses-call-urgent-aid

publisher: World Council of Churches / Human Rights Monitor

text.en: The World Council of Churches relayed Human Rights Monitor’s account of increased deployments and raids, naming Nduga, Puncak and Intan Jaya among the main affected regencies. The report links military operations with community fears, including around schools and healthcare. This is a monitoring assessment, not a new census of displaced people. Sources: World Council of Churches / Human Rights Monitor https://www.oikoumene.org/news/human-rights-groups-see-extreme-increase-in-military-deployments-and-operations-in-papua
text.pmy: Dewan Gereja Dunia meneruskan laporan Human Rights Monitor tentang peningkatan pengerahan pasukan dan penggerebekan, dengan Nduga, Puncak, serta Intan Jaya sebagai wilayah utama terdampak. Laporan menghubungkan operasi dengan ketakutan masyarakat, termasuk di sekitar sekolah dan layanan kesehatan. Catatan ini merupakan penilaian pemantauan, bukan pendataan baru pengungsi. Sumber: World Council of Churches / Human Rights Monitor https://www.oikoumene.org/news/human-rights-groups-see-extreme-increase-in-military-deployments-and-operations-in-papua

text.en: HRM’s April–June 2026 report records further operations and concerns for displaced civilians. Its regional totals are not a count for this case alone. Sources: Human Rights Monitor https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/
text.pmy: Laporan HRM April–Juni 2026 mencatat operasi berikutnya serta kekhawatiran bagi warga pengungsi. Jumlah regional bukan jumlah kasus ini saja. Sumber: Human Rights Monitor https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/

text.pmy: ANTARA mewawancarai tenaga kesehatan yang meminta evakuasi setelah dua guru dibunuh. Kios tutup dan ketakutan mengganggu akses pangan serta layanan. Sumber: ANTARA https://papua.antaranews.com/berita/629122/pengungsi-beoga-puncak-minta-dievakuasi-persediaan-makanan-mulai-menipis

title.en: Gold Rush report examines mining and security
title.pmy: Laporan Gold Rush membahas tambang dan keamanan

text.en: Amnesty’s Gold Rush report examines proposed mining at Wabu and a security environment in which residents described violence, restrictions and displacement. The report connects questions about consent for extraction with people’s ability to remain on their land and speak freely about development plans. Sources: Amnesty International https://www.amnesty.org/en/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/ASA2152572022ENGLISH.pdf
text.pmy: Laporan Gold Rush Amnesty membahas rencana pertambangan Wabu dan situasi keamanan ketika warga melaporkan kekerasan, pembatasan, serta pengungsian. Kajian menghubungkan persetujuan atas pertambangan dengan kemampuan masyarakat tinggal di tanahnya dan menyampaikan pendapat tentang rencana pembangunan. Sumber: Amnesty International https://www.amnesty.org/en/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/ASA2152572022ENGLISH.pdf

text.en: PT Freeport Indonesia dates its first contract with Indonesia to 1967, before Pepera. This corporate record establishes the contractual chronology. Sources: Freeport-McMoRan https://www.fcx.com/about/history
text.pmy: PT Freeport Indonesia mencatat kontrak pertamanya dengan Indonesia pada 1967, sebelum Pepera. Catatan perusahaan ini menjadi sumber kronologi kontrak. Sumber: Freeport-McMoRan https://www.fcx.com/about/history

text.en: Freeport-McMoRan dates the original Ertsberg copper project’s operation to 1973. The development connected the highland mine with processing and transport in the lowlands, turning the contract into an extensive industrial presence in Mimika. Sources: Freeport-McMoRan https://www.fcx.com/about/history
text.pmy: Freeport-McMoRan mencatat proyek tembaga Ertsberg mulai beroperasi pada 1973. Pengembangan menghubungkan tambang pegunungan dengan pengolahan serta angkutan di dataran rendah, mengubah kontrak menjadi kehadiran industri yang luas di Mimika. Sumber: Freeport-McMoRan https://www.fcx.com/about/history

text.en: The company’s history records discovery of the Grasberg deposit in 1988 and expansion of operations afterwards. This marks the shift from the original Ertsberg project to the much larger copper and gold operation followed today. Sources: Freeport-McMoRan https://www.fcx.com/about/history
text.pmy: Riwayat perusahaan mencatat penemuan deposit Grasberg pada 1988 dan perluasan operasi setelahnya. Peristiwa ini menandai peralihan dari proyek Ertsberg menuju operasi tembaga dan emas yang jauh lebih besar dan masih dipantau sekarang. Sumber: Freeport-McMoRan https://www.fcx.com/about/history

text.en: PTFI entered a new 30-year contract with provisions for two ten-year extensions. It established the next contractual stage of mining development; questions about customary land, livelihoods and environmental effects require sources beyond the corporate contractual record. Sources: Freeport-McMoRan https://www.fcx.com/about/history
text.pmy: PTFI memasuki kontrak baru selama 30 tahun dengan ketentuan dua perpanjangan sepuluh tahun. Kontrak menetapkan tahap berikutnya pengembangan tambang, sementara persoalan tanah adat, penghidupan, dan lingkungan perlu dibaca melalui sumber selain catatan kontrak perusahaan. Sumber: Freeport-McMoRan https://www.fcx.com/about/history

text.en: PTFI records completion of the transaction giving Indonesia a 51.2% majority stake. Ownership changes do not by themselves settle customary-land or environmental questions. Sources: PT Freeport Indonesia https://ptfi.co.id/en/about/history
text.pmy: PTFI mencatat selesainya transaksi yang memberi Indonesia kepemilikan mayoritas 51,2%. Perubahan kepemilikan tidak dengan sendirinya menyelesaikan persoalan tanah adat atau lingkungan. Sumber: PT Freeport Indonesia https://ptfi.co.id/en/about/history

text.en: PTFI commemorated workers killed in the September 2025 wet-material incident and February–March 2026 shootings. It reported production at 40–50% during recovery; its target was not a completed result. Sources: PT Freeport Indonesia https://ebk.ptfi.co.id/id/video/hut-ke-59-freeport-bangkit-bersama-menuju-operasi-berkelanjutan
text.pmy: PTFI mengenang pekerja yang meninggal dalam insiden material basah September 2025 serta penembakan Februari–Maret 2026. Perusahaan melaporkan produksi 40–50% selama pemulihan; sasaran produksi bukan hasil yang sudah tercapai. Sumber: PT Freeport Indonesia https://ebk.ptfi.co.id/id/video/hut-ke-59-freeport-bangkit-bersama-menuju-operasi-berkelanjutan
