title.pmy: Gag Nikel kembali beroperasi dengan pengawasan

publisher: The Jakarta Post / Asia News Network

text.en: A September report citing the energy ministry dates Gag Nikel’s resumption to 3 September after a temporary suspension. The government promised stricter monitoring and rehabilitation. Gag’s operation is separate from the four companies whose permits were revoked in June. Sources: The Jakarta Post / Asia News Network https://asianews.network/indonesia-government-vows-stricter-oversight-as-gag-nikel-restarts-raja-ampat-mine/
text.pmy: Laporan September yang mengutip Kementerian ESDM mencatat Gag Nikel kembali beroperasi pada 3 September setelah penghentian sementara. Pemerintah menjanjikan pemantauan dan rehabilitasi lebih ketat. Operasi Gag berbeda dari empat perusahaan yang izinnya dicabut pada Juni. Sumber: The Jakarta Post / Asia News Network https://asianews.network/indonesia-government-vows-stricter-oversight-as-gag-nikel-restarts-raja-ampat-mine/

title.en: Court upholds access to revocation records

text.en: Greenpeace reports that PTUN Jakarta rejected BKPM’s objection to disclosing the four revocation decisions and their implementation details, affirming the Central Information Commission’s decision. Sources: Greenpeace Indonesia https://www.greenpeace.org/indonesia/siaran-pers/67809/greenpeace-menang-ptun-perintahkan-pemerintah-buka-sk-pencabutan-izin-4-tambang-nikel-di-raja-ampat/
text.pmy: Greenpeace melaporkan bahwa PTUN Jakarta menolak keberatan BKPM atas pembukaan empat keputusan pencabutan serta rincian pelaksanaannya, menguatkan putusan Komisi Informasi Pusat. Sumber: Greenpeace Indonesia https://www.greenpeace.org/indonesia/siaran-pers/67809/greenpeace-menang-ptun-perintahkan-pemerintah-buka-sk-pencabutan-izin-4-tambang-nikel-di-raja-ampat/

text.en: Greenpeace’s account dates PT Indo Asiana Lestari’s preliminary location permit to 2017. The proposed plantation covered Woro clan land near Yare, Fofi, in Boven Digoel. The later lawsuit challenged environmental approval and the lack of information and consultation described by customary owners. Sources: Greenpeace Southeast Asia https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/58630/west-papuan-indigenous-defender-files-lawsuit-over-palm-oil-company-forestland-grab/
text.pmy: Greenpeace mencatat izin lokasi awal PT Indo Asiana Lestari pada 2017. Rencana perkebunan mencakup tanah marga Woro sekitar Yare, Fofi, di Boven Digoel. Gugatan berikutnya mempersoalkan persetujuan lingkungan serta kekurangan informasi dan konsultasi yang disampaikan pemilik adat. Sumber: Greenpeace Southeast Asia https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/58630/west-papuan-indigenous-defender-files-lawsuit-over-palm-oil-company-forestland-grab/

text.en: Awyu land defender Hendrikus (Franky) Woro filed a lawsuit against PT Indo Asiana Lestari’s environmental approval. Greenpeace’s account describes customary forest as the source of food, work and inherited social responsibilities, and records objections to a decision communities said they had not agreed to. Sources: Greenpeace Southeast Asia https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/58630/west-papuan-indigenous-defender-files-lawsuit-over-palm-oil-company-forestland-grab/
text.pmy: Pembela tanah Awyu Hendrikus (Franky) Woro menggugat persetujuan lingkungan PT Indo Asiana Lestari. Greenpeace menggambarkan hutan adat sebagai sumber pangan, pekerjaan, dan tanggung jawab sosial antargenerasi serta mencatat keberatan atas keputusan yang menurut masyarakat tidak mereka setujui. Sumber: Greenpeace Southeast Asia https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/58630/west-papuan-indigenous-defender-files-lawsuit-over-palm-oil-company-forestland-grab/

text.en: The Jayapura administrative court rejected Woro’s environmental lawsuit. Greenpeace described the ruling as a setback and recorded his intention to continue the legal challenge. This first-instance decision precedes the 2024 cassation outcome; the IAL case should be distinguished from other Awyu-related company cases. Sources: Greenpeace Southeast Asia https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/62817/verdict-a-setback-for-awyu-indigenous-people-and-papuan-forests/
text.pmy: Pengadilan tata usaha negara Jayapura menolak gugatan lingkungan Woro. Greenpeace menyebut putusan sebagai kemunduran dan mencatat niatnya melanjutkan upaya hukum. Putusan tingkat pertama mendahului hasil kasasi 2024; perkara IAL perlu dibedakan dari perkara perusahaan lain yang terkait masyarakat Awyu. Sumber: Greenpeace Southeast Asia https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/62817/verdict-a-setback-for-awyu-indigenous-people-and-papuan-forests/

publisher: WALHI / Save Papuan Customary Forests Coalition

text.en: WALHI and the coalition report that decision 458 K/TUN/LH/2024 rejected Hendrikus Woro’s cassation concerning PT Indo Asiana Lestari’s environmental approval. One judge dissented. Sources: WALHI / Save Papuan Customary Forests Coalition https://www.walhi.or.id/mahkamah-agung-tolak-kasasi-suku-awyu-perjuangan-selamatkan-hutan-papua-kian-berat
text.pmy: WALHI bersama koalisi melaporkan bahwa putusan 458 K/TUN/LH/2024 menolak kasasi Hendrikus Woro terkait persetujuan lingkungan PT Indo Asiana Lestari. Satu hakim berbeda pendapat. Sumber: WALHI / Save Papuan Customary Forests Coalition https://www.walhi.or.id/mahkamah-agung-tolak-kasasi-suku-awyu-perjuangan-selamatkan-hutan-papua-kian-berat

text.en: HRW documents racist abuse against Papuan students, the August 2019 protests, arrests and subsequent discrimination. Sources: Human Rights Watch · 2024 https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/09/18/if-its-not-racism-what-is-it/discrimination-and-other-abuses-against-papuans-in
text.pmy: HRW mendokumentasikan penghinaan rasis terhadap mahasiswa Papua, protes Agustus 2019, penangkapan, serta diskriminasi berikutnya. Sumber: Human Rights Watch · 2024 https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/09/18/if-its-not-racism-what-is-it/discrimination-and-other-abuses-against-papuans-in

text.en: After throttling on 19 August, the government shut down internet access from 21 August to 4 September in cities and regencies across Papua and West Papua. AJI and SAFEnet challenged the restrictions. Columbia’s case analysis explains how the interruption affected access to information and freedom of expression during the protests. Sources: Columbia Global Freedom of Expression https://globalfreedomofexpression.columbia.edu/cases/alliance-of-independent-journalists-v-minister-of-communication/
text.pmy: Setelah pelambatan pada 19 Agustus, pemerintah memutus akses internet pada 21 Agustus–4 September di kota dan kabupaten Papua serta Papua Barat. AJI dan SAFEnet menggugat pembatasan tersebut. Analisis perkara Columbia membahas gangguan akses informasi dan kebebasan berekspresi saat protes berlangsung. Sumber: Columbia Global Freedom of Expression https://globalfreedomofexpression.columbia.edu/cases/alliance-of-independent-journalists-v-minister-of-communication/

title.pmy: Pengadilan menyatakan pemutusan internet melanggar hukum

text.en: Amnesty reports the Jakarta administrative court ruling that government internet throttling and shutdown in Papua in 2019 were unlawful. Sources: Amnesty International Indonesia · 2020 https://www.amnesty.id/kabar-terbaru/siaran-pers/court-ruling-on-internet-blackout-is-a-rare-victory-for-freedom-of-expression-in-papua/06/2020/
text.pmy: Amnesty melaporkan putusan pengadilan administrasi Jakarta bahwa pelambatan dan pemutusan internet oleh pemerintah di Papua pada 2019 melanggar hukum. Sumber: Amnesty International Indonesia · 2020 https://www.amnesty.id/kabar-terbaru/siaran-pers/court-ruling-on-internet-blackout-is-a-rare-victory-for-freedom-of-expression-in-papua/06/2020/

text.en: HRM’s April–June monitoring records intimidation and dispersal of Pesta Babi screenings. The documentary was released online on 22 May 2026. Sources: Human Rights Monitor https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/
text.pmy: Pemantauan HRM April–Juni mencatat intimidasi dan pembubaran pemutaran Pesta Babi. Film dokumenter tersebut dirilis daring pada 22 Mei 2026. Sumber: Human Rights Monitor https://humanrightsmonitor.org/id/laporan/papua-monitor-kuartal-ii-2026-konflik-yang-semakin-memanas-serangan-drone-dan-pengungsian-massal/

text.en: The Merauke Integrated Food and Energy Estate launched a large-scale agribusiness programme on customary land. Ginting and Pye trace how concessions, government planning and corporate investment met Malind land relations and resistance. It provides the background for later projects, without making MIFEE and the 2023–24 rice and sugar programmes one continuous legal scheme. Sources: Ginting & Pye · ASEAS (2013) https://aseas.univie.ac.at/index.php/aseas/article/view/2571/2159
text.pmy: Merauke Integrated Food and Energy Estate memulai program agribisnis skala besar di tanah adat. Ginting dan Pye menelusuri pertemuan konsesi, perencanaan pemerintah, dan investasi perusahaan dengan hubungan masyarakat Malind atas tanah serta perlawanan mereka. Kajian ini memberi latar bagi proyek berikutnya; dasar hukum dan pelaku tiap program tetap perlu ditelusuri sendiri. Sumber: Ginting & Pye · ASEAS (2013) https://aseas.univie.ac.at/index.php/aseas/article/view/2571/2159

text.en: TAPOL’s statement raised concerns about forest conversion, food security and Malind customary rights under MIFEE. These objections precede the present food estate debate: land described as available for investment was already sustaining communities’ food, work and social relations. Sources: TAPOL https://tapol.org/press-statements/mifee-project-violates-human-rights
text.pmy: Pernyataan TAPOL mempersoalkan alih fungsi hutan, ketahanan pangan, dan hak adat Malind dalam MIFEE. Keberatan ini muncul sebelum perdebatan food estate sekarang: tanah yang disebut tersedia bagi investasi telah menopang pangan, pekerjaan, dan hubungan sosial masyarakat. Sumber: TAPOL https://tapol.org/press-statements/mifee-project-violates-human-rights

text.en: Regulation 8/2023 added the Merauke Food and Energy Development Area to the national strategic project list. Pusaka reports that the policy was established without meaningful deliberation and agreement with affected Indigenous communities. The designation concerns a development area; it does not itself establish consent for every plantation or rice-field site. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Peraturan 8/2023 menambahkan Kawasan Pengembangan Pangan dan Energi Merauke ke daftar proyek strategis nasional. Pusaka mencatat kebijakan ini ditetapkan tanpa musyawarah dan persetujuan yang bermakna dari masyarakat adat terdampak. Penetapan kawasan pembangunan belum menunjukkan adanya persetujuan untuk setiap lokasi perkebunan atau sawah. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Pusaka records a land-use conformity approval for PT Murni Nusantara Mandiri in Animha, Jagebob and Sota. This is one company’s sugarcane plan, separate from the new rice-field project around Wanam. Following the approvals separately helps identify which company, programme and customary territory a dispute concerns. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka mencatat persetujuan kesesuaian kegiatan pemanfaatan ruang bagi PT Murni Nusantara Mandiri di Animha, Jagebob, dan Sota. Rencana tebu perusahaan ini berbeda dari proyek sawah baru sekitar Wanam. Penelusuran izin secara terpisah membantu mengetahui perusahaan, program, dan wilayah adat yang terkait dengan suatu sengketa. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: A consultation in Kartini, Jagebob, addressed the environmental impact assessment for PT Murni Nusantara Mandiri’s sugarcane plantation and sugar factory. Pusaka includes this administrative step in the timeline. The later objections concern both the adequacy of information and communities’ ability to decide about their land. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Konsultasi di Kartini, Jagebob, membahas penyusunan AMDAL perkebunan tebu dan pabrik gula PT Murni Nusantara Mandiri. Pusaka mencatat tahap administrasi ini dalam linimasanya. Keberatan masyarakat berikutnya menyangkut kecukupan informasi serta kesempatan untuk mengambil keputusan atas tanah mereka. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Merauke Regent Romanus Mbaraka met the deputy defence minister to discuss land management for the food estate programme. The meeting placed the defence ministry within the project’s coordination, alongside agricultural and regional authorities. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Bupati Merauke Romanus Mbaraka bertemu wakil menteri pertahanan untuk membahas pengelolaan lahan program food estate. Pertemuan ini menempatkan Kementerian Pertahanan dalam koordinasi proyek bersama instansi pertanian dan pemerintah daerah. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: The agriculture minister, deputy defence minister, military officers and regional officials held a coordination meeting in Merauke and visited the rice harvest in Kuper, Semangga. Their stated aim was to expand food production. These rice activities should be read separately from the sugar and bioethanol task force established two days later. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Menteri pertanian, wakil menteri pertahanan, pejabat militer, dan pemerintah daerah mengadakan rapat koordinasi di Merauke serta mengunjungi panen padi di Kuper, Semangga. Pemerintah menyatakan tujuan peningkatan produksi pangan. Kegiatan padi ini perlu dibaca terpisah dari satgas gula dan bioetanol yang dibentuk dua hari kemudian. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Presidential Decision 15/2024 established a task force to accelerate sugar and bioethanol investment in Merauke. Led by the investment minister, it coordinates licensing and investment facilitation for sugarcane, sugar processing, bioethanol and biomass power. This decision concerns those industries, rather than every rice-field development described as a food estate. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/; Sekretariat Kabinet https://setkab.go.id/pemerintah-bentuk-satgas-swasembada-gula-dan-bioetanol-di-merauke/
text.pmy: Keputusan Presiden 15/2024 membentuk satgas percepatan investasi gula dan bioetanol di Merauke. Dipimpin menteri investasi, satgas mengoordinasikan perizinan dan fasilitasi investasi tebu, pengolahan gula, bioetanol, serta pembangkit biomassa. Keputusan ini menyangkut industri tersebut, bukan seluruh pengembangan sawah yang disebut food estate. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/; Sekretariat Kabinet https://setkab.go.id/pemerintah-bentuk-satgas-swasembada-gula-dan-bioetanol-di-merauke/

text.en: Pusaka dates the start of PT Global Papua Abadi’s forest clearing in Sermayam, Tanah Miring, to May 2024. The month is recorded without an exact day. This is the sugarcane location that the president later visited in July. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka mencatat awal pembukaan hutan oleh PT Global Papua Abadi di Sermayam, Tanah Miring, pada Mei 2024, tanpa tanggal hari yang pasti. Lokasi tebu ini kemudian dikunjungi presiden pada Juli. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Investment Minister Bahlil Lahadalia and accompanying officials inspected land for sugar and bioethanol development from the air. Pusaka records his public description of the landscape and concerns about how forests and other ecosystems were being assessed for conversion. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Menteri Investasi Bahlil Lahadalia bersama pejabat lainnya meninjau lahan pengembangan gula dan bioetanol dari udara. Pusaka mencatat pernyataan publiknya tentang bentang lahan serta persoalan penilaian hutan dan ekosistem lain yang akan dialihfungsikan. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Pusaka records the arrival of J7Explorer, owned by businessman Andi Syamsuddin Arsyad of Jhonlin Group, at Merauke port. The vessel’s later activity around Wobikel became one of the matters on which local communities sought information. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka mencatat kedatangan kapal J7Explorer milik pengusaha Andi Syamsuddin Arsyad dari Jhonlin Group di pelabuhan Merauke. Kegiatan kapal berikutnya sekitar Wobikel menjadi salah satu hal yang dimintakan penjelasannya oleh masyarakat setempat. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

title.pmy: Mesin pertanian dikirim melalui kapal TNI AL

text.en: The navy vessel KRI dr. Soeharso delivered agricultural machinery at Yos Sudarso port. Pusaka records tractors, rice transplanters and harvesters among the agriculture ministry’s assistance. The delivery illustrates the logistical role of military transport in the agricultural programme. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: KRI dr. Soeharso milik TNI AL mengirim bantuan mesin pertanian di pelabuhan Yos Sudarso. Pusaka mencatat traktor, mesin tanam padi, dan pemanen dalam bantuan Kementerian Pertanian. Pengiriman ini menunjukkan peran angkutan militer dalam logistik program pertanian. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

title.en: Military command assigned to rice-field opening
title.pmy: Komando pembukaan sawah diserahkan kepada militer

text.en: Pusaka cites Agriculture Minister Amran Sulaiman assigning control of the planned large-scale rice-field opening to the XVII/Cenderawasih military commander. The proposed area includes customary territories of Malind, Maklew, Khimaima and Yei communities. The statement concerns operational command; the communities’ later responses address land rights and consent. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka mengutip Menteri Pertanian Amran Sulaiman yang menempatkan kendali rencana pembukaan sawah skala besar pada Pangdam XVII/Cenderawasih. Rencana kawasan mencakup wilayah adat Malind, Maklew, Khimaima, dan Yei. Pernyataan itu menyangkut komando pelaksanaan; tanggapan masyarakat berikutnya menyangkut hak atas tanah dan persetujuan. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Pusaka reports J7Explorer operating in waters near Wobikel, Ilwayab, and describes activity suspected to be survey work for the rice-field project. It records community concerns that the purpose and plans had not been explained. The timeline gives a month, not a verified day or a confirmed account of everyone aboard. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka melaporkan kegiatan J7Explorer di perairan sekitar Wobikel, Ilwayab, yang diduga terkait survei proyek sawah. Masyarakat mempertanyakan maksud dan rencana kegiatan yang belum dijelaskan kepada mereka. Sumber mencatat bulan kejadian tanpa tanggal hari yang pasti. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Yei customary leaders Godefridus Galep Inagijai and Absalom Can Kapaiter signed a statement rejecting investment plans in Yei territory. Pusaka records its delivery at a meeting with the company and environmental consultants in Sermayam. This is a documented community position, rather than an inference from the project’s permit status. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pemimpin adat Yei Godefridus Galep Inagijai dan Absalom Can Kapaiter menandatangani pernyataan penolakan rencana investasi di wilayah Yei. Pusaka mencatat penyampaiannya dalam pertemuan dengan perusahaan dan konsultan lingkungan di Sermayam. Pernyataan ini mencatat sikap masyarakat secara langsung. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Khimaima and Malind Maklew community members, young people and students demonstrated at the Merauke legislature. They opposed investment in their customary territories and sought an explanation of vessel and helicopter activity. Their demands linked access to information with the right to decide about land use. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Masyarakat Khimaima dan Malind Maklew bersama pemuda serta mahasiswa beraksi di DPRD Merauke. Mereka menolak investasi di wilayah adat dan meminta penjelasan tentang kegiatan kapal serta helikopter. Tuntutan tersebut menghubungkan hak atas informasi dengan hak menentukan penggunaan tanah. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Khimaima and Malind Maklew representatives returned to the Merauke legislature, opposing sugarcane investment permits and asking the regent to formally prohibit investment in their customary areas. Pusaka records this as a further action following the 13 June demonstration. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Perwakilan Khimaima dan Malind Maklew kembali mendatangi DPRD Merauke, menolak izin investasi tebu dan meminta bupati melarang investasi secara resmi di wilayah adat mereka. Pusaka mencatat tindakan lanjutan setelah aksi 13 Juni. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: At a meeting with Khimaima and Malind Maklew representatives, Romanus Mbaraka said the regency had not been officially informed about the sugarcane investment discussed for Kimaam and Ilwayab or the vessel in Wanam waters. Pusaka records this statement alongside communities’ requests for information. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Dalam pertemuan dengan perwakilan Khimaima dan Malind Maklew, Romanus Mbaraka mengatakan pemerintah kabupaten belum memperoleh informasi resmi tentang investasi tebu yang dibicarakan untuk Kimaam dan Ilwayab maupun kapal di perairan Wanam. Pusaka mencatat pernyataan ini bersama permintaan informasi masyarakat. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: The agriculture minister inspected land optimisation in Kurik. Machinery support and more frequent planting were presented as ways to raise rice production. This activity concerns improving existing agricultural land and should not be conflated with every new forest-clearing site. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Menteri pertanian meninjau optimalisasi lahan di Kurik. Dukungan mesin dan peningkatan frekuensi tanam disampaikan sebagai cara menaikkan produksi padi. Kegiatan ini menyangkut peningkatan penggunaan lahan pertanian dan perlu dibedakan dari pembukaan hutan di lokasi baru. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Pusaka identifies Environment and Forestry Ministry Decision 835/2024 as an approval for forest-area use by the defence ministry for food-security infrastructure in Merauke. It records that the document circulated publicly in August as questions about the rice-field project’s legal basis increased. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka mengidentifikasi Keputusan Menteri Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan 835/2024 sebagai persetujuan penggunaan kawasan hutan oleh Kementerian Pertahanan untuk sarana ketahanan pangan di Merauke. Dokumen disebut beredar pada Agustus, ketika pertanyaan tentang dasar hukum proyek sawah meningkat. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Pusaka records a meeting on 15–16 July concerning the handover of customary-land rights to PT Murni Nusantara Mandiri in Jagebob, Sota and Animha. It took place at the military district command’s Animha hall in Merauke with company, landowner, government, police and military representatives. The meeting record alone does not establish the terms accepted by every affected landholder. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka mencatat pertemuan 15–16 Juli tentang penyerahan hak tanah adat kepada PT Murni Nusantara Mandiri di Jagebob, Sota, dan Animha. Pertemuan berlangsung di aula Animha, Makodim Merauke, dengan perwakilan perusahaan, pemilik tanah, pemerintah, polisi, dan militer. Catatan pertemuan belum menjelaskan syarat yang diterima setiap pemilik tanah terdampak. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Military leaders, defence officials, South Papua’s acting governor and Jhonlin Group’s owner inspected the food-security and rice-field project location in Wanam by helicopter. Pusaka places this visit before the arrival of heavy equipment later in July. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pemimpin militer, pejabat pertahanan, penjabat gubernur Papua Selatan, dan pemilik Jhonlin Group meninjau lokasi program ketahanan pangan serta sawah di Wanam dengan helikopter. Pusaka mencatat kunjungan sebelum kedatangan alat berat pada akhir Juli. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: President Joko Widodo attended sugarcane planting at PT Global Papua Abadi in Sermayam, Tanah Miring, and visited agricultural land optimisation in Telaga Sari. The Cabinet Secretariat presented sugarcane development as part of food and energy security. These official aims sit alongside the community objections recorded elsewhere in this timeline. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/; Sekretariat Kabinet https://setkab.go.id/tanam-tebu-perdana-di-merauke-presiden-pemerintah-fokus-kembangkan-ketahanan-pangan/
text.pmy: Presiden Joko Widodo menghadiri penanaman tebu PT Global Papua Abadi di Sermayam, Tanah Miring, dan mengunjungi optimalisasi lahan pertanian di Telaga Sari. Sekretariat Kabinet menyampaikan pengembangan tebu sebagai bagian dari ketahanan pangan dan energi. Tujuan resmi ini dibaca bersama keberatan masyarakat dalam linimasa. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/; Sekretariat Kabinet https://setkab.go.id/tanam-tebu-perdana-di-merauke-presiden-pemerintah-fokus-kembangkan-ketahanan-pangan/

title.pmy: Dengar pendapat dengan MRP Papua Selatan

text.en: Khimaima and Malind Maklew representatives met the South Papua People’s Assembly. Pusaka records demands to reject investment in their customary territories, halt vessel and helicopter activity, and revoke business permits. The hearing brought those requests to the province’s Indigenous representative institution. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Perwakilan Khimaima dan Malind Maklew bertemu Majelis Rakyat Papua Selatan. Pusaka mencatat tuntutan menolak investasi di wilayah adat, menghentikan kegiatan kapal dan helikopter, serta mencabut izin usaha. Dengar pendapat membawa tuntutan tersebut ke lembaga perwakilan masyarakat adat tingkat provinsi. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Pusaka records protests in Wobikel on 28–29 July as heavy equipment arrived by barge at the PT Dwi Karya jetty. Jhonlin Group’s owner and senior defence and military officials attended the unloading. Community objections concerned the arrival and the authorities’ conduct; the source’s inconsistent equipment totals are not reproduced here. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka mencatat protes di Wobikel pada 28–29 Juli ketika alat berat tiba melalui tongkang di dermaga PT Dwi Karya. Pemilik Jhonlin Group bersama pejabat pertahanan dan militer menghadiri pembongkaran. Keberatan masyarakat menyangkut kedatangan alat dan tindakan aparat. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Community representatives, young people, students and local leaders met in Payum, Merauke, and agreed to reject sugarcane and oil-palm plantation projects. Pusaka records this meeting as part of the organising that preceded the Kondo Digul forum. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Perwakilan masyarakat, pemuda, mahasiswa, dan tokoh setempat bertemu di Payum, Merauke, serta menyepakati penolakan proyek perkebunan tebu dan sawit. Pusaka mencatat pertemuan ini sebagai bagian pengorganisasian sebelum terbentuknya forum Kondo Digul. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

title.pmy: Pembukaan lahan dan keberatan di Wanam

text.en: Pusaka reports excavators clearing forests, hamlets and swamps in Wanam, and community objections that the work proceeded without landholders’ deliberation and agreement. It records negotiations involving John Gluba Gebze and the operator while clearing continued. These are Pusaka’s field accounts of the rice-field project. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka melaporkan ekskavator membuka hutan, dusun, dan rawa di Wanam serta keberatan masyarakat karena pekerjaan berlangsung tanpa musyawarah dan persetujuan pemilik tanah. Sumber mencatat perundingan yang melibatkan John Gluba Gebze dan operator sementara pembukaan berlanjut. Entri ini mengikuti laporan lapangan Pusaka tentang proyek sawah. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Between 12 and 14 August, communities in Wambi, Es Wambi, Woboyu and Bibikem carried out sasi rituals to protect land and oppose plantation operations. Pusaka records these actions in Okaba, Tubang and Ilwayab. The restrictions express customary authority over the land, alongside written statements and formal hearings. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pada 12–14 Agustus, masyarakat Wambi, Es Wambi, Woboyu, dan Bibikem melaksanakan sasi untuk melindungi tanah serta menolak kegiatan perkebunan. Pusaka mencatat tindakan ini di Okaba, Tubang, dan Ilwayab. Sasi menyatakan kewenangan adat atas tanah, berdampingan dengan pernyataan tertulis dan dengar pendapat resmi. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Pusaka reports a meeting in Domande, Malind, where a military village liaison officer conveyed PT Borneo Citra Persada’s sugarcane investment plan. The community rejected the proposal. This entry concerns that company and location, rather than the Sermayam or Wanam developments. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka melaporkan pertemuan di Domande, Malind, ketika seorang Babinsa menyampaikan rencana investasi tebu PT Borneo Citra Persada. Masyarakat menolak rencana tersebut. Entri ini menyangkut perusahaan dan lokasi itu, berbeda dari pengembangan Sermayam maupun Wanam. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: A further meeting in Payum brought together community representatives, students, young people and South Papua MRP members. They agreed to reject sugarcane, oil-palm and food estate projects and formed the Kondo Digul Indigenous Peoples Forum, coordinated by Simon Balagaize. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pertemuan lanjutan di Payum mempertemukan perwakilan masyarakat, mahasiswa, pemuda, dan anggota MRP Papua Selatan. Mereka menyepakati penolakan proyek tebu, sawit, serta food estate dan membentuk Forum Masyarakat Adat Kondo Digul dengan koordinator Simon Balagaize. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Pusaka’s timeline records changes in the management and shareholding of PT Agro Industri Nasional and identifies people holding defence, agricultural and political roles. The underlying company filing is not reproduced in the timeline. This entry preserves the organisation’s reported finding without treating it as an independently verified account of ultimate ownership. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Linimasa Pusaka mencatat perubahan pengurus dan kepemilikan saham PT Agro Industri Nasional serta menyebut tokoh dengan jabatan pertahanan, pertanian, dan politik. Dokumen perusahaan yang mendasari catatan itu tidak ditampilkan dalam linimasa. Entri ini mencatat temuan yang dilaporkan Pusaka. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

title.en: Agriculture and military officials visit Wanam
title.pmy: Pejabat pertanian dan militer mengunjungi Wanam

text.en: The agriculture minister and senior defence and military officials visited the new rice-field project via Wanam airport in Wogekel, Ilwayab. Pusaka records the visit as work continued and community opposition remained unresolved. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Menteri pertanian bersama pejabat senior pertahanan dan militer mengunjungi proyek sawah baru melalui bandara Wanam di Wogekel, Ilwayab. Pusaka mencatat kunjungan ketika pekerjaan berlanjut dan keberatan masyarakat belum terselesaikan. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

title.pmy: Keberatan masyarakat dan pengakuan wilayah Yei

text.en: In Wobikel, residents directly told acting Governor Rudy Sufahriadi that they opposed Jhonlin Group’s rice-field project. On the same date, a separate ceremony in Kweel, Eligobel, saw the regent sign recognition and protection of Yei customary rights and territory. These were distinct events in different places. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Di Wobikel, warga menyampaikan langsung kepada Penjabat Gubernur Rudy Sufahriadi bahwa mereka menolak proyek sawah Jhonlin Group. Pada tanggal yang sama, dalam kegiatan terpisah di Kweel, Eligobel, bupati menandatangani pengakuan serta pelindungan hak dan wilayah adat Yei. Keduanya merupakan peristiwa di tempat berbeda. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: The TNI commander inaugurated five new infantry battalions for Papua at Monas in Jakarta. Pusaka records the stated role of supporting security and development in vulnerable areas. The following day’s objections show why the organisational expansion belongs in the land-project chronology. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Panglima TNI meresmikan lima batalyon infanteri baru untuk Papua di Monas, Jakarta. Pusaka mencatat tujuan resmi mendukung keamanan dan pembangunan di daerah rawan. Keberatan pada hari berikutnya menunjukkan kaitan perluasan organisasi ini dengan linimasa proyek tanah. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

title.en: Solidarity groups object to new battalions

text.en: Solidaritas Merauke and the Kondo Digul forum protested the plan for five new infantry battalions in Papua. Pusaka records the objection alongside continuing disputes about the food and energy projects. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Solidaritas Merauke dan Forum Kondo Digul memprotes rencana lima batalyon infanteri baru di Papua. Pusaka mencatat keberatan tersebut bersama sengketa yang berlanjut mengenai proyek pangan dan energi. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: Pusaka reports finding forest clearing by PT Murni Nusantara Mandiri in Nalkin, Jagebob, and estimates that work had begun in August. The date marks the reported observation, rather than a verified first day of clearing. This is a sugarcane-company site, separate from the Wanam rice-field project. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka melaporkan temuan pembukaan hutan oleh PT Murni Nusantara Mandiri di Nalkin, Jagebob, dan memperkirakan kegiatan dimulai sejak Agustus. Tanggal ini menandai temuan yang dilaporkan, bukan kepastian hari pertama pembukaan. Lokasi perusahaan tebu ini berbeda dari proyek sawah Wanam. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

text.en: The Kondo Digul forum met and held a press conference in Payum, restating community rejection of the Merauke national strategic project. Pusaka includes this collective statement near the end of its documented period. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Forum Kondo Digul mengadakan pertemuan dan konferensi pers di Payum, menegaskan kembali penolakan masyarakat terhadap proyek strategis nasional Merauke. Pusaka mencatat pernyataan bersama ini menjelang akhir periode linimasanya. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

title.pmy: Aksi diam dalam pertemuan dengan gubernur

text.en: Pusaka records another meeting between the acting governor, John Gluba Gebze and people in Wogikel. Most affected participants remained silent and declined to express their views. The timeline ends here; later reporting appears in the current picture and news sections rather than being inferred from this meeting. Sources: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/
text.pmy: Pusaka mencatat pertemuan lanjutan antara penjabat gubernur, John Gluba Gebze, dan masyarakat Wogikel. Sebagian besar peserta terdampak melakukan aksi diam dan menolak menyampaikan pendapat. Linimasa Pusaka berakhir di sini; perkembangan berikutnya tersedia dalam gambaran terkini dan berita. Sumber: Pusaka Bentala Rakyat https://pusaka.or.id/en/lini-masa/merauke-national-strategic-project-timeline/

title.en: Environmental permit for the Merauke road

publisher: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka

text.en: Greenpeace’s later court account dates the road’s environmental permit to September 2025, while reporting that clearing and construction had begun in August 2024. The chronology of work and authorisation became part of the Malind communities’ challenge. Sources: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/69267/court-rejected-indigenous-malind-peoples-lawsuit-challenging-a-135-km-roadway-destroying-customary-forest/
text.pmy: Laporan perkara Greenpeace mencatat izin lingkungan jalan pada September 2025, sementara pembukaan serta pembangunan disebut telah dimulai pada Agustus 2024. Urutan pekerjaan dan perizinan menjadi bagian gugatan masyarakat Malind. Sumber: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/69267/court-rejected-indigenous-malind-peoples-lawsuit-challenging-a-135-km-roadway-destroying-customary-forest/

title.en: Five Malind plaintiffs challenge road permit
title.pmy: Lima penggugat Malind menggugat izin jalan

publisher: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka

text.en: Simon Petrus Balagaize, Sinta Gebze, Liborius Kodai Moiwend, Kanisius Dagil and Andreas Mahuze filed a lawsuit against the environmental permit for the 135-kilometre Merauke road. According to the advocacy team, communities had not given free, prior and informed consent. The road supports the wider food and energy developments. Sources: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/69267/court-rejected-indigenous-malind-peoples-lawsuit-challenging-a-135-km-roadway-destroying-customary-forest/
text.pmy: Simon Petrus Balagaize, Sinta Gebze, Liborius Kodai Moiwend, Kanisius Dagil, dan Andreas Mahuze menggugat izin lingkungan jalan sepanjang 135 kilometer di Merauke. Menurut tim advokasi, masyarakat belum memberikan persetujuan atas dasar informasi di awal tanpa paksaan. Jalan menopang pengembangan pangan dan energi yang lebih luas. Sumber: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/69267/court-rejected-indigenous-malind-peoples-lawsuit-challenging-a-135-km-roadway-destroying-customary-forest/

publisher: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka

text.en: Greenpeace reports that the presiding judge ordered the defendant to halt road construction on 9 June. Its September account nevertheless describes continued construction and a road network extending 135 kilometres. This records the advocacy team’s account of the order and its implementation. Sources: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/69267/court-rejected-indigenous-malind-peoples-lawsuit-challenging-a-135-km-roadway-destroying-customary-forest/
text.pmy: Greenpeace melaporkan hakim ketua memerintahkan tergugat menghentikan pembangunan jalan pada 9 Juni. Laporan September masih mencatat pembangunan berlanjut dan jaringan jalan mencapai 135 kilometer. Entri ini mengikuti penuturan tim advokasi tentang perintah serta pelaksanaannya. Sumber: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/69267/court-rejected-indigenous-malind-peoples-lawsuit-challenging-a-135-km-roadway-destroying-customary-forest/

title.en: Jayapura court rejects Malind road lawsuit
title.pmy: Pengadilan Jayapura menolak gugatan jalan Malind

publisher: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka

text.en: The Jayapura administrative court dismissed the road-permit lawsuit. Greenpeace reports that the judges accepted the permit’s legality and consultation record, while the plaintiffs and advocacy team disputed the adequacy of consultation and the treatment of evidence. Simon Balagaize said the community would continue defending customary land. Sources: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/69267/court-rejected-indigenous-malind-peoples-lawsuit-challenging-a-135-km-roadway-destroying-customary-forest/
text.pmy: Pengadilan tata usaha negara Jayapura menolak gugatan izin jalan. Greenpeace melaporkan hakim menerima keabsahan izin dan catatan konsultasi, sementara penggugat serta tim advokasi mempersoalkan kecukupan konsultasi dan penilaian bukti. Simon Balagaize menyatakan masyarakat akan terus mempertahankan tanah adat. Sumber: Greenpeace / Malind advocacy team · including Pusaka https://www.greenpeace.org/southeastasia/press/69267/court-rejected-indigenous-malind-peoples-lawsuit-challenging-a-135-km-roadway-destroying-customary-forest/

text.en: Archives, historical research and the struggle for self-determination.
text.pmy: Arsip, penelitian sejarah, dan perjuangan penentuan nasib sendiri.

text.en: Social life, kinship, art, belief and cultural memory.
text.pmy: Kehidupan sosial, kekerabatan, seni, kepercayaan, dan ingatan budaya.

text.en: Customary land, tenure, consent, displacement and Indigenous control over territory.
text.pmy: Tanah adat, hak atas tanah, persetujuan, penggusuran, dan kendali masyarakat adat atas wilayah.

text.en: Mining, plantations, logging, large projects, permits and their social and ecological consequences.
text.pmy: Tambang, perkebunan, pembalakan, proyek besar, izin, dan dampak sosial-ekologinya.

text.en: Forests, watersheds, reefs, species, protected areas and ecological change across Western New Guinea.
text.pmy: Hutan, daerah aliran air, terumbu, spesies, kawasan lindung, dan perubahan ekologi di Papua bagian barat.

text.en: Fire, drought, floods, rainfall extremes, landslides and climate-related risks.
text.pmy: Kebakaran, kekeringan, banjir, hujan ekstrem, longsor, dan risiko terkait iklim.

text.en: Civilian protection, violence, militarization, displacement, detention and access for independent monitoring.
text.pmy: Perlindungan warga, kekerasan, militerisasi, pengungsian, penahanan, dan akses pemantauan independen.

text.en: Political status, autonomy, institutions, elections, representation and public decision-making.
text.pmy: Status politik, otonomi, lembaga, pemilu, keterwakilan, dan pengambilan keputusan publik.

text.en: Work, markets, fisheries, agriculture, local enterprise, resource revenue and household livelihoods.
text.pmy: Kerja, pasar, perikanan, pertanian, usaha lokal, pendapatan sumber daya, dan mata pencaharian rumah tangga.

text.en: Health care, nutrition, food systems, water, housing and access to essential public services.
text.pmy: Layanan kesehatan, gizi, sistem pangan, air, perumahan, dan akses layanan publik penting.

text.en: Schools, knowledge, Indigenous languages, cultural transmission, arts, memory and expression.
text.pmy: Sekolah, pengetahuan, bahasa adat, pewarisan budaya, seni, ingatan, dan ekspresi.

text.en: Women’s leadership, gender-based violence, care, disability, youth and unequal access to rights and services.
text.pmy: Kepemimpinan perempuan, kekerasan berbasis gender, perawatan, disabilitas, pemuda, dan ketimpangan akses hak dan layanan.

text.en: Roads, ports, aviation, communications, energy systems and unequal physical or digital access.
text.pmy: Jalan, pelabuhan, penerbangan, komunikasi, sistem energi, dan ketimpangan akses fisik atau digital.

text.en: Displacement since 2018, access to schools and healthcare, and the conditions for returning home.
text.pmy: Pengungsian sejak 2018, akses sekolah dan layanan kesehatan, serta kondisi untuk pulang.

text.en: Mining, river tailings, land and livelihoods from the highlands to the Mimika coast.
text.pmy: Pertambangan, tailing sungai, tanah dan penghidupan dari pegunungan hingga pesisir Mimika.

text.en: Access to shelter, services and home amid renewed displacement.
text.pmy: Akses tempat tinggal, layanan dan kampung halaman di tengah pengungsian.

text.en: Civilian displacement and access to assistance around Sugapa and surrounding districts.
text.pmy: Pengungsian warga dan akses bantuan di Sugapa serta distrik sekitarnya.

text.en: The ability to report, organize, assemble and express Papuan perspectives in public.
text.pmy: Ruang untuk meliput, berorganisasi, berkumpul, dan menyampaikan pandangan orang Papua di hadapan publik.

text.en: Forest permits, oil palm expansion and recognition of Awyu land rights in Boven Digoel.
text.pmy: Izin hutan, perluasan sawit dan pengakuan hak atas tanah Awyu di Boven Digoel.

title.en: South Papua food and energy estate
title.pmy: Proyek pangan dan energi Papua Selatan

text.en: South Papua food and energy estate
text.pmy: Proyek pangan dan energi Papua Selatan
